comment: Trailer narration. One line per entry; `shot` and `at` place it on the timeline of the take it belongs to. The voice chain is the narrator generator's, so the trailer is read by the game's own sound.

lines.text: First light on the straits. The beachhead holds, for now.
Armour moves before the sun clears the ridge.
Then the line meets the line.
Street by street. House by house.
Dug in behind concrete, they wait for you to break them.
Rotors in low, ahead of the column.
Modern Combined Arms. Build the base. Break the line.
